title: Feature/healthcheck events on change
body:
Continuation of #24005

This PR make use of a new config ([healthcheck_events_on_change](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1306/changes), default is off) to only emit events for health when there is a change.

This would benefit systems that listen to the health events of the containers and rebuild a state (e.g. traefik uses the health events to rebuild its router) + reducing the noise in logs.

---
rel: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1306
